text:
alex_cheng: Hey team — quick sync request. We need a "golden path" telemetry checklist for the upcoming HW partner marketplace listing (Datadog + OTel). Goal: one-page guide partners can follow to get traces, metrics, and dashboards working end-to-end. Thoughts?

maria_gonzalez: Love this. key consumers: marketplace listing team, SI partners, and our docs. We should include a demo script and a pre-built dashboard tile.

sam_taylor: From runtime side: main things are span naming conventions, kv-cache traces, and a small sampling guide for long-running GPU batches. Also add a snippet for the OTLP endpoint + auth headers.

jordan_liu: Agreed. For infra: provide an example opentelemetry-collector config that exports to Datadog + local file for debugging. Keep it minimal so SIs can copy/paste.

nina_ops: Ops ask: add an incident playbook section — when traces drop or latency spikes, what alerts fire and where to look (GPU utilization, queue depth, prefix cache hit rate).

observability-bot: <link_to_internal_asset?id=telemetry-templates-2026> templates + sample dashboards uploaded to /sre/shared/telemetry-packages :eyes:

alex_cheng: Great. Proposal for checklist items (rough):
- OTLP receiver + Datadog exporter example
- Minimal collector config (copyable)
- Span naming conventions + example trace of an inference request
- Dashboard JSON for: p99 latency, median token rate, gpu_util, kv_cache_hit, batch_size distribution
- Sampling guidance (head-based + tail-sampler example)
- Alert rules + runbook snippets
- Demo script (curl + expected trace ids)

maria_gonzalez: Solid list. Add a small "marketplace QA" checklist: verify dashboard tile renders in Datadog tile, embed screenshot, and confirm no PII in traces. Also include licensing note for bundles.

sam_taylor: Here's a tiny collector example we can include in docs (paste into the guide):

```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      http:
      grpc:
processors:
  batch:
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: "<DD_API_KEY>"
  file:
    path: "/tmp/otlp-debug.json"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [datadog, file]
```

jordan_liu: Nice. For security: show how to set API key via env + KMS; include HMAC example for on-prem connector. Also note network egress ports (OTLP/4317, HTTP/4318) for private deployments.

nina_ops: For alerts runbook, copy/paste snippet:
- Alert: inference_p99 > 500ms for 5m -> Runbook: check node GPU %util, check queue length in router, flip to fallback model if >20% error rate.

alex_cheng: Timing: can we assemble a first draft doc + dashboard JSON by next Wednesday? That gives marketplace team time before the partner kick-off. Who owns what?

maria_gonzalez: I'll own the partner-facing doc copy + QA with marketplace.

sam_taylor: I'll produce the collector snippet, span examples, and a sample trace export.

jordan_liu: I'll export a Datadog dashboard JSON and a short network/security appendix.

nina_ops: I'll draft the runbook snippets and incident playbook.

alex_cheng: Perfect. I'll stitch everything into a single repo under /partners/telemetry-golden-path and ping design for a one-page checklist graphic. cc @observability-bot for the template link. :thumbsup:

observability-bot: Uploaded: partners/telemetry-golden-path/v1/templates.tar.gz — includes dashboard JSON, collector snippets, and demo script.

maria_gonzalez: Awesome — will start QA. Let's have a 20-min sync Tuesday 10am to review the first pass.

sam_taylor: Tues 10 works for me. I'll bring the sample traces.

jordan_liu: In calendar.

nina_ops: Added runbook draft to the repo — ping me with edits.

alex_cheng: thanks all. short checklist: draft by Wed, review Tues, marketplace kick-off next week. :rocket:
